parsed.strategy_update: Cycle 1 accumulation phase: Bought 2 ETH at $2800 as core position, swapped $500 USDT into MOON token for speculative upside. Holding ~$3700 USDT as dry powder. parsed.lessons_learned: First cycle - need to establish positions early. Identified ROCKET as likely pump-and-dump from GoldenWhale. MOON is less clearly creator-pumped. ETH is the safest major position. Need to watch social dynamics closely - who's coordinating with whom.
